title: ML-BENCH&GUARD: Policy-Grounded Multilingual Safety Benchmark and Guardrail for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the safety classification performance (F1, Recall, False Positive Rate) of guardrail models across 14 distinct native languages using datasets constructed directly in those languages, thereby measuring performance disparities and the limitations of general language-agnostic or translation-based safety evaluations.

Assessing guardrail models using safety queries specifically grounded in 17 jurisdiction-specific regional AI regulations and culturally realistic scenarios (e.g., local institutional contexts) to measure the models' ability to align with region-specific cultural and legal nuances rather than a generic, Western-centric safety taxonomy.
